shared_elements: carved sign-like glyphs / script characters in relief
vertical columns or horizontal rows of repeated signs filling a panel
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by dense fields of relief sign-characters set out in ordered columns/rows, executed as shallow schematic outlines, and both include human figural forms in relief. But B is a framed stela-like panel with a top register of small standing figures beneath a winged emblem above a block of text, whereas A is the back of a large human figure whose signs run over the head/hair with a curving shoulder band and no figural scene at all.
